def verify(cert, x, y, ridge, l0, box):
    p = x.shape[1]
    w = np.asarray(cert['weights'])
    r = x @ w - y
    f = 0.5 * (r @ r + ridge * (w @ w)) + l0 * np.count_nonzero(abs(w) > 1e-08)
    assert w.shape == (p,) and np.max(abs(w)) <= box and (abs(f - cert['objective']) < 1e-09)
    leaves = cert['subcube_leaves']
    assert 1 <= len(leaves) <= 2048, len(leaves)
    allbits = np.arange(1 << p, dtype=np.int32)
    covered = np.zeros(1 << p, dtype=np.int8)
    gram = x.T @ x
    for leaf in leaves:
        (z, k) = (leaf['fixed_zero'], leaf['fixed_active'])
        assert len(z) == len(k) == p and all((type(v) is bool for v in z + k))
        assert not any((a and b for (a, b) in zip(z, k)))
        zm = sum((1 << j for (j, v) in enumerate(z) if v))
        km = sum((1 << j for (j, v) in enumerate(k) if v))
        covered[allbits & (zm | km) == km] += 1
        d = np.asarray(leaf['minorant_diagonal'])
        c = np.asarray(leaf['minorant_center'])
        assert np.min(d) >= 0 and np.linalg.eigvalsh(gram - np.diag(d))[0] >= -1e-08
        g = gram @ c - x.T @ y
        b = g - d * c
        a = d + ridge
        u = np.array([min(box, abs(bj) / aj) if aj > 0 else box for (aj, bj) in zip(a, b)])
        opt = 0.5 * a * u * u - abs(b) * u + l0
        base = 0.5 * np.sum((x @ c - y) ** 2) - g @ c + 0.5 * np.dot(d, c * c)
        check = base + sum((0 if zz else oo if kk else min(0, oo) for (zz, kk, oo) in zip(z, k, opt)))
        assert leaf['lb'] <= check + 1e-08, (leaf['lb'], check)
    assert (covered == 1).all()
    assert cert['certified_lower_bound'] <= min((q['lb'] for q in leaves)) + 1e-09
    gap = f - cert['certified_lower_bound']
    assert -1e-09 <= gap <= 1e-05, (gap, len(leaves))
    return (len(leaves), gap)

def oracle(x, y, ridge, l0, box):
    import itertools
    p = x.shape[1]
    q = x.T @ x + ridge * np.eye(p)
    b = x.T @ y
    best = 0.5 * (y @ y)
    for face in itertools.product((0, 1, -1, 2), repeat=p):
        f = np.array(face)
        j = f == 2
        k = abs(f) == 1
        w = np.zeros(p)
        w[k] = box * f[k]
        if np.any(j):
            w[j] = np.linalg.solve(q[np.ix_(j, j)], b[j] - q[np.ix_(j, k)] @ w[k])
        if np.max(abs(w)) > box + 1e-10:
            continue
        r = x @ w - y
        best = min(best, 0.5 * (r @ r + ridge * (w @ w)) + l0 * np.count_nonzero(abs(w) > 1e-08))
    return best
